+/// Represents a change to the cookies visible to the current page.
+    /// Gets the cookies that were created or changed.
+    /// Gets the cookies that were deleted. Their <see cref="CookieListItem.Value"/> is <see langword="null"/>.
+    // CookieListItem is a dictionary, so the lists are copied whole.
+    /// Gets the event that fires when cookies visible to the current page change.
+    public static EventType<CookieStore, CookieChangeEvent> ChangeEvent { get; }
/// Gets the first cookie with the specified name.
+    /// Adds a listener that is called each time the specified event fires on the cookie store.
+    /// Other listeners, including those added by JavaScript code of the page, are not affected.
+    /// An exception thrown by the listener is logged and does not remove the listener.
+    /// Each call creates an independent registration, even for the same listener;
+    /// disposing the returned object removes only that registration.
+    /// <typeparam name="TEvent">The type of the event object.</typeparam>
+    /// <param name="type">The event to listen for, such as <see cref="ChangeEvent"/>.</param>
+    /// <param name="listener">The function to call with each event.</param>
+    /// <returns>An object that removes the listener when disposed.</returns>
+    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException"><paramref name="type"/> or <paramref name="listener"/> is <see langword="null"/>.</exception>
+    /// <exception cref="NotSupportedException">The browser does not provide the Cookie Store API for the current page.</exception>
+    public ValueTask<IAsyncDisposable> AddEventListenerAsync<TEvent>(EventType<CookieStore, TEvent> type, Func<TEvent, Task> listener)
+    /// Adds a listener that is called each time the specified event fires on the cookie store.
+    /// Other listeners, including those added by JavaScript code of the page, are not affected.
+    /// An exception thrown by the listener is logged and does not remove the listener.
+    /// Each call creates an independent registration, even for the same listener;
+    /// disposing the returned object removes only that registration.
+    /// Canceling <paramref name="cancellationToken"/> removes the listener, as disposing the returned object does.
+    /// <typeparam name="TEvent">The type of the event object.</typeparam>
+    /// <param name="type">The event to listen for, such as <see cref="ChangeEvent"/>.</param>
+    /// <param name="listener">The function to call with each event.</param>
+    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The token that removes the listener when canceled.</param>
+    /// <returns>An object that removes the listener when disposed.</returns>
+    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException"><paramref name="type"/> or <paramref name="listener"/> is <see langword="null"/>.</exception>
+    /// <exception cref="OperationCanceledException"><paramref name="cancellationToken"/> was canceled before the listener was added.</exception>
+    /// <exception cref="NotSupportedException">The browser does not provide the Cookie Store API for the current page.</exception>
+    public async ValueTask<IAsyncDisposable> AddEventListenerAsync<TEvent>(EventType<CookieStore, TEvent> type, Func<TEvent, Task> listener, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+        // Adding and removing listeners changes unlocked state, so these awaits keep the renderer's synchronization context.
+        return await type.AddListenerAsync(_listeners, cookieStore, this, listener, cancellationToken);
+        // Listeners need the cookie store reference to remove themselves, so they go first.
// Don't wait for a pending acquisition. It could hold up scope disposal until the JS interop timeout.

+/// One listener added with <c>addEventListener</c>. Disposing it or canceling its token removes the listener.
+    public EventListener(EventListenerCollection owner, IJSObjectReference target, string type, Func<TEvent, Task> listener, CancellationToken cancellationToken, ILogger logger)
+    public async Task AddAsync(JSCallbackFactory callbackFactory, string shapesJson)
+        var callback = new JSCallback<TEvent> { Handler = InvokeListenerAsync };
+        // Disposal can run while the function is being created, and then nothing else releases it.
+    /// Removes the listener when its token is canceled. Call it once the listener is added.
+        // Not useSynchronizationContext: its Send blocks forever when Cancel runs on Blazor's renderer context.
+        // Removal changes unlocked state, so it runs on the context that added the listener.
+        // A call that left the browser before removal can still arrive.
+        // A failed removal still releases both references, and then reaches the caller.
+                    // The page is already gone, so nothing can call the listener.
+// Licensed to the .NET Foundation under one or more agreements.

+/// Tracks the listeners added to one event target, so that scope disposal can remove them all.
+    /// Adds a listener for <paramref name="type"/> to <paramref name="target"/>.
+    /// <returns>The handle that removes the listener when disposed.</returns>
+        var eventListener = new EventListener<TEvent>(this, target, type, listener, cancellationToken, _logger);
+            // The exception of the failed addition is the useful one.
+            // Decided by the token, not by the error, as for other canceled browser operations.
+        // The token can be canceled while addEventListener is on its way.
+        // Scope disposal can run while addEventListener is on its way, and it has already removed this listener.
+        [LoggerMessage(2, LogLevel.Warning, "A listener could not be removed from its event target.", EventName = "ListenerRemovalFailed")]
+        public static partial void ListenerRemovalFailed(ILogger logger, Exception exception);
+        [LoggerMessage(1, LogLevel.Error, "A listener for the '{EventType}' event threw an exception.", EventName = "ListenerThrew")]
+        public static partial void ListenerThrew(ILogger logger, string eventType, Exception exception);

+/// Identifies an event that a <typeparamref name="TTarget"/> fires, and the type of the event object that listeners receive.
+/// <typeparam name="TTarget">The type of the object that fires the event.</typeparam>
+/// <typeparam name="TEvent">The type of the event object.</typeparam>
+public sealed class EventType<TTarget, TEvent> where TTarget : class
+    private readonly Func<EventListenerCollection, IJSObjectReference, TTarget, Func<TEvent, Task>, CancellationToken, Task<IAsyncDisposable>> _addListenerAsync;
+        Func<EventListenerCollection, IJSObjectReference, TTarget, Func<TEvent, Task>, CancellationToken, Task<IAsyncDisposable>> addListenerAsync)
+    /// Gets the name of the event, such as <c>"change"</c>.
+    internal Task<IAsyncDisposable> AddListenerAsync(EventListenerCollection listeners, IJSObjectReference target, TTarget owner, Func<TEvent, Task> listener, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+/// Creates <see cref="EventType{TTarget, TEvent}"/> instances. The event object types are known here,
+/// so the public methods that add listeners need no trimming annotations.
+    /// Creates an event whose object crosses to .NET as <typeparamref name="TEvent"/> itself.
+    /// <param name="shapesJson">The <c>ArgumentShape</c> list (see <c>js/Platform.ts</c>) that copies the event object.</param>
+    public static EventType<TTarget, TEvent> Create<TTarget, [DynamicallyAccessedMembers(LinkerFlags.JsonSerialized)] TEvent>(
+        => new(name, (listeners, target, _, listener, cancellationToken) => listeners.AddAsync(target, name, shapesJson, listener, cancellationToken));
+    /// Creates an event whose object crosses to .NET as <typeparamref name="TPayload"/> and is then converted,
+    /// for members such as <c>storageArea</c> that refer to an existing projection.
+    /// <param name="shapesJson">The <c>ArgumentShape</c> list (see <c>js/Platform.ts</c>) that copies the event object.</param>
+    /// <param name="convert">The function that creates the event object from the target and the payload.</param>
+    public static EventType<TTarget, TEvent> Create<TTarget, [DynamicallyAccessedMembers(LinkerFlags.JsonSerialized)] TPayload, TEvent>(
+            listeners.AddAsync<TPayload>(target, name, shapesJson, payload => listener(convert(owner, payload)), cancellationToken));

/// Provides what a projection needs when it is created, shared by all projections of the scope.
+    // Typed as the interface, so that disposal does not keep the type in an app that never adds a listener.
/// Gets the JS runtime of the scope.
+    /// Creates the collection that a projection uses to add event listeners to its JavaScript object.
+    // Window calls this last, after every listener that needs the module is removed.

+// Objects that the functions created by JSCallbackFactory call. The browser can call such a function
+// before a handler is set or after it is removed, so a missing handler is not an error.
+    public Func<T1, Task>? Handler { get; set; }
+    public Task Invoke(T1 arg1) => Handler?.Invoke(arg1) ?? Task.CompletedTask;
